score_method: Minimum mandatory visual-area score, not an average; every mandatory static visual check must pass strictly above 9.0.
pending_separate_evidence: Full GitHub byte/blob readback and independent archive gate
preservation: All previous source identities, original accepted images, rejected iterations and exact prompts remain preserved.

areas.finding: The Atlas golden-brown spotted lynx remains a compact feline with dark ear tufts, broad cheek ruff, pale muzzle/chest and short bobtail, with no companion equipment.
Four cardinal views and two distinct obliques are readable and complete, exposing all major surfaces and the short tail.
Four feline legs and grounded broad paws resolve in profiles and obliques, with coherent hock direction and no extra or missing limb.
Two pointed ears carry dark tufts; golden eyes, cheek markings, pale mouth/chest and broad cheek ruff remain coherent across the view set.
A single very short raised bobtail attaches at the rump, visibly confirmed in both profiles, rear and rear oblique. No long snow-leopard tail or duplicated appendage is substituted.
Golden coat, dark scattered flank/leg spots and pale underside retain a coherent distribution across rotations. Small spot contours are illustrative, not an exact reusable native texture map.
Rounded sculpted fur, clear eyes, clean studio ground and uncropped ear tufts/paws support the Havenline static-reference style.

source_interpretation_limit: The original Atlas supplies a small single-pose source appearance. Hidden reverse anatomy, fur grouping and fine texture placement are authored concept interpretation. Static sheets do not establish a native mesh, rig, animation or gameplay implementation.
minor_polish_limit: Individual spot contours and fine fur strands vary slightly between angles; the major spotted distribution, color blocks, bobtail and anatomy remain consistent.
